subject.title: feat(goal-driver): completion contracts, wait barriers, and an optional completion judge

question: Should the experimental goal driver permanently expose completion contracts, wait barriers, and an LLM completion judge as core persisted state, model tools, and configuration?
rationale: Even after mechanical correctness repairs, this introduces durable session contracts and an optional model-call policy surface that require explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Land deterministic primitives
options.body: Sponsor completion contracts and wait barriers first while deferring the LLM judge until its value and operating behavior are proven.

options.title: Sponsor the full surface
options.body: Approve all three capabilities as one experimental direction after the blockers and proof gap are resolved.

options.title: Decline the expansion
options.body: Keep the existing bounded continuation driver and improve convergence through simpler goal-status guidance instead.

recommendation.title: Land deterministic primitives
recommendation.body: Sponsor completion contracts and wait barriers first while deferring the LLM judge until its value and operating behavior are proven.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a repository-level product and compatibility choice rather than a mechanical implementation decision.
